terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.acceptanceText: By using SplitSmart, you accept these terms of service in their entirety. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you should not use the application.
terms.appDescriptionText: SplitSmart is a mobile application for managing and splitting shared expenses between users. The application allows creating events, adding expenses, managing participants, and calculating balances.
terms.userResponsibilitiesText:
• Provide accurate and updated information
• Maintain account confidentiality
• Use the application responsibly and legally
• Do not attempt to access other users' data
terms.dataPrivacyText: We are committed to protecting your privacy. Data is stored locally on your device. For more information, see our Privacy Policy.
terms.limitationsText: SplitSmart is provided "as is". We do not guarantee that the service will be uninterrupted or error-free. We are not responsible for data loss or incorrect calculations due to user errors.
terms.modificationsText: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Modifications will be effective when published in the application.
terms.contactText: For questions about these terms, contact: soporte@splitsmart.com

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introductionText: At SplitSmart, we value and respect your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
privacy.dataCollectionText:
• Profile information (name, email, phone)
• Event and expense data you enter
• Application usage information
• Technical device data (model, operating system)
privacy.dataUseText:
• Provide and improve our services
• Process expense and balance calculations
• Send relevant notifications
• Provide technical support
• Develop new features
privacy.dataStorageText: All your data is stored locally on your mobile device. We do not send or store personal information on external servers. You have complete control over your data.
privacy.dataSharingText: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties. Data is only shared when you explicitly share event information with other users.
privacy.dataSecurityText: We implement security measures to protect your information. However, no storage method is 100% secure. We recommend keeping your device secure.
privacy.userRightsText:
• Access: You can view all your data at any time
• Modification: You can edit your information
• Deletion: You can delete your account and all data
• Portability: You can export your data
privacy.contactText: If you have questions about this privacy policy, you can contact us through the "Contact Support" section.

support.beforeContactText: We recommend reviewing the following options that might resolve your query:

support.beforeItem4: • Check if other users reported the same problem
